name: Cill Dalua

attributes.attribute: Irish for the church of Dalua

text: Cill Dalua is an Irish place-name that means the church of a man named Dalua. The name lives on in Killaloe, the modern town that stands on the Shannon in County Clare, Ireland. That town grew up around a monastery linked with St Flannan. MacKillop treats this headword as a cross-reference to his entry on Killaloe.

okr.objective: Cill Dalua is the Irish place-name behind Killaloe in County Clare.
key_results: Cill Dalua is Irish for the church of Dalua.
The name survives in Killaloe, a town on the Shannon in County Clare.
The Killaloe site grew around a monastery linked with St Flannan.
